svg.text: Developed cylindrical surface only; original vector study, no CAD or print acceptance.
lower-body sample band, ODref 34.8, circumference repeat count 30
shared angular datum theta0 at seam; texture band clips from a larger assembled-space lattice
Rise 0.6 mm with 1 mm flat top
Equal end margins from complete rows: 3.067 mm
Coupon note: 5.6 mm cap window only fits one row at the main pitch.
Two rows need 2.8 mm axial pitch or a shorter transition.
At 2.8 mm pitch, 0.6 rise is 33.69 deg.
Global phase rule: keep one assembled Z0 and theta0, then clip full cells to allowed bands.
